caption:
Eggs Kejriwal
high protein | lazy girl breakfast | iconic mumbai egg dish 

From the streets of mumbai to fancy New York restaurants, this humble breakfast dish has travelled the world! 

Why the name?
Eggs Kejriwal owes its name to a prominent socialite, Mr. Devi Prasad Kejriwal, who frequented the Willingdon Club in Mumbai. Legend has it that Mr. Kejriwal, a vegetarian, ordered a special egg dish by describing his preferred ingredients. The dish became a sensation and eventually was named after him.

Nutrition: 
C: 12 | F: 14 | P: 19
Calories: 292 per serve 
Makes 2 servings

Ingredients
knobb of butter
4 eggs 
2 cloves of garlic, thinly sliced 
1 onion, finely chopped
2 - 3 green chillies, finely chopped
30 grams grated cheese
chopped coriander for garnish 

Method
add butter to the pan followed by garlic, chilli and half the chopped onion
cook for a few minutes then crack in the eggs 
let them cook for a few minutes till egg whites cook then and add on grated cheese, remaining onion and coriander
enjoy on some toasted pav or bread :)
